quote: Sometimes I sit in the dark, wondering where all the years went. I watch the clock hands move, counting down my silent regrets. Every memory feels like glass, shattering beneath my heavy tread. I wish I could turn back time, undoing every painful mistake. But the past stays frozen, leaving me to wander alone. We are only ghosts haunting our own history.
